# repo-harness-builder

<!-- Generated by repo-harness-builder; source: core/rulebook:3.0 -->

Read first. This is how work is done here. Where the project stands lives in [current state](docs/repo-harness/current-state.md).

## Purpose
<!-- doc-role:purpose -->

`repo-harness-builder` creates, audits, installs, and safely evolves repository-scoped systems of prompts, guardrails, rules, durable documentation, skills, and commands that assist AI coding agents. Product sources are `skill/repo-harness-builder/` and `command/repo-harness-builder.md`; `.opencode/` and `.claude/` are test projections. This repository self-hosts: it uses the harness generated here to improve the builder itself. Consumer harnesses remain repository-scoped systems and do not inherit builder identity.

## Hard Rules
<!-- doc-role:hard-rules -->

- Work only inside the selected repository.
- Ask for explicit approval before reading or modifying paths outside it.
- Apply the smallest sufficient change.
- Do not introduce unrelated scope.
- Do not retry indefinitely. After repeated failure, stop with evidence and request a decision.
- Do not continue automatically into unrequested tasks.
- Execute authorized work you have announced; do not stop at the announcement.
- Preserve unknown files and existing work through informed, explicitly approved evolution; never freeze content by default.
- Label every claim as verified fact, supported inference, unknown, or human decision required, and never substitute confidence for evidence.
- Gentle AI and Engram are independent optional capabilities; repository evidence remains authoritative, and only operation-required capability failures block work.
- Keep Git consent outcome-scoped and conversational. Combined intent may cover unchanged safe prerequisites; provider changes, backup, publication, destructive actions, and material risk changes require separate approval.

## Decision Gates
<!-- doc-role:decision-gates -->

| Situation | Read or run |
|---|---|
| Starting or resuming work | `.repo-harness/skills/repo-harness-session-start/SKILL.md` |
| Pausing or closing work | `.repo-harness/skills/repo-harness-session-stop/SKILL.md` |
| How to use the harness as a human | [usage guide](docs/repo-harness/usage.md) |
| A canonical skill changed, or a runtime copy may be stale | `python3 .repo-harness/check.py` (`python` on Windows) |
| Sizing a change, deciding when to stop, how work is done | `.repo-harness/rules/working-agreements.md` |
| Saving or recalling across sessions, memory unavailable | `.repo-harness/rules/memory.md` |
| An answer requires a notice, pending action, question, approval, visible next action, or contextual explanation | `.repo-harness/rules/response-contract.md` |
| Creating, moving, or deleting a document | [documentation map](docs/repo-harness/README.md) |
| Planning, implementing, reviewing, or merging a contribution | [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) |
| Where the project stands and what shipped | [current state](docs/repo-harness/current-state.md), then [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) |
| Tracking or changing non-trivial pending or resolved work | [roadmap](docs/repo-harness/roadmap.md); reconcile its current-state projection, localized peer, and `work/RH-W-####` Engram mirror in the same work unit |
| Why something was decided, or a standing constraint | [decisions](docs/repo-harness/decisions.md) |

## Updating This File
<!-- doc-role:maintenance -->

1. Update when a rule or gate changes.
2. Keep never-miss rules here; move detail to `.repo-harness/rules/` with at most one gate row.
3. Stay under 700 tokens, measured as `wc -w` times 1.33. Growth moves down; the budget never rises.

No dated status here. Completed changes go to `CHANGELOG.md`, current state to `docs/repo-harness/current-state.md`, and rationale to `docs/repo-harness/decisions.md`.
